title: onprem: airgap offline bundle - vendor rke2 debian apt-mirror & vendoring updates
author: Priya Shah
ci_status: pass (image-publish job flaky on first run, rerun succeeded)
description:
Context: Customers deploying Redwood Private in air-gapped Debian/Raspbian-based environments hit two recurring gaps: 1) upstream apt repository vendoring and 2) RKE2 vendor/manifest handling for Debian kernels and initramfs. This PR packages improvements to the offline bundle creation pipeline to support Debian-based distros (including Debian 11/12 and Ubuntu 22.04 family), adds an optional local apt-mirror step, and vendors updated RKE2 artifacts with TUF metadata integration.

What this PR does (single continuous description): Added an `apt-mirror` stage to the offline bundle generator that pulls and rewrites APT indices for selected packages, produces a compressed apt-mirror artifact, and wires the installer to point to the local apt mirror during on-prem install. Vendor updates: bumped RKE2 runtime to 1.26.4-rke2 with Debian-specific systemd unit tweaks, vendored kernel modules for common edge device platforms, and added explicit initramfs hooks to preserve TUF-protected signatures. TUF: regenerate delegated metadata for the vendored apt artifacts and add verification hooks to the installer so the air-gapped installer validates package signatures before install. Rollback/upgrade tooling: extend the offline rollback tooling to record apt mirror snapshot manifests and validate package checksums during rollback to prevent partial upgrades.

Motivation: Customers on regulated networks requested reproducible offline bundles that include apt dependencies and RKE2 binaries with verified metadata. Previously, Debian users had to mirror packages manually; this PR automates that step and ensures the installer can use the local mirror reliably for upgrades/rollbacks.

High-level changes: - offline-bundle: new `apt-mirror` job and CLI flag `--include-apt-mirror` - bundler: add apt index rewrite step, tarball compression with zstd and deterministic mtime - vendor: update rke2 artifacts, add deb-specific unit files under `packaging/debian` - installer: new config `use_local_apt_mirror: true/false`, apt sources.list template pointing to bundled mirror - tuf: metadata delegation and verification hooks in the installer runtime - rollback: mirror manifest recording and checksum verification on rollback

Checklist: - [x] bundler: apt-mirror implementation and tests - [x] packaging: rke2 vendor updates and unit tests - [x] installer: integration with local mirror and TUF validation - [x] e2e: airgap install on Debian 12 VM in CI matrix (mocked network) - [x] docs: quickstart and troubleshooting notes added to `docs/onprem/airgap.md`

Backward compatibility and upgrade notes: The default behavior is unchanged (apt-mirror not included). Existing bundles continue to work. Enabling the apt mirror is opt-in via the bundler flag and installer config. When enabled, upgrades will prefer packages from the bundled mirror; rollback will verify mirror snapshots to avoid partial state.

Related: SUP-1023 (support ticket), ENG-4578 (engineering work item), linked PRs: #118234 (debian vendoring baseline).
